source: JPL Horizons API (https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/api/horizons.api), target 10 (Sun), observer geodetic site at 0 m, QUANTITIES=4, APPARENT=AIRLESS (no refraction), 1-minute steps over the app's night window (mean solar noon + 24 h). Crossing instants are linear interpolations between the two bracketing Horizons samples; spot values are every 60th sample, unmodified.
